title: The Exclusion Map
description: Ethereum's MEV-Boost relays mapped by inclusion policy (neutral → OFAC-censoring) and block-delivery share. 38.6% of blocks censor. Tap a relay to see what it can deny an AI agent; toggle FOCIL to watch the exclusion risk collapse.

toggle FOCIL to see EIP-7805 neutralize the censoring zone
